item.title: Scheffler has another slow start and was happy to get a weekend at Riviera
item.description: Scottie Scheffler gave a light fist pump when his final putt barely curled in on the 18th hole at Riviera, typical of his subdued reaction when he wins most tournaments. The difference Friday is the putt allowed him to make the cut on the number at the Genesis Invitational. item.title: Augusta mom jailed after taking blame for son’s accident with motorcycle
item.description: An Augusta mother was locked up last week after telling deputies that she was behind the wheel in an accident that seriously injured a motorcyclist on Wheeler Road.
